question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains centralized authority over the Chinese Communist Party and People's Liberation Army with no visible internal challenges or succession signals, supporting the 95.5% trader consensus against an exit before 2027. Recent personnel decisions and party gatherings have reinforced continuity rather than transition ahead of the scheduled 2027 National Congress. The lack of term limits and tight control over elite appointments create significant structural barriers to removal. Plausible but low-probability shifts could still include sudden health developments or major elite realignments triggered by economic or foreign policy setbacks, though no such verified catalysts have appeared in recent reporting.
